text:
alex.m: Heads up — I need to leave at 6pm PT and @priya.k is swapping into evening coverage. Quick sanity check before I go: VPN access, pager bindings, runbook link, and any short-lived creds we should refresh?

priya.k: Got it. Can you confirm the VPN jump host and whether the corp cert expires tonight? I can test before you head out.

alex.m: VPN is the usual: vpn.redwood-internal.example.com. Certs are via our SSO; expiry for my session is 09:12pm PT. If you need to reauth: `redwoodctl auth login --mfa` (works with Okta). Runbook: https://redwood-internal.runbooks/ops/oncall-evening

sam: quick note — PagerPro subscription for the routing team is active, but the alert webhook key rotated last week. Confirmed the team key is in KMS path `projects/redwood/keys/pagerpro-routing`. If you can't decrypt, ping infra.

priya.k: testing VPN now...

infra-bot: vpn-check: OK — able to reach bastion (10.2.3.45) from priya.k's IP. ssh via bastion:
```
ssh -J priya@bastion.redwood redwood-admin@10.0.20.5
```

priya.k: I can SSH to the bastion and then to the admin jump. Redwoodctl auth worked, MFA prompt showed.

alex.m: For pager testing, do NOT trigger a production alert. Use the test endpoint: `curl -X POST https://pager.redwood.test/send -d '{"routing_key":"test-routing-key","message":"pager-test"}'` — only goes to the oncall test rota.

oncall-bot: pager-assignment: priya.k is now primary for 18:00-02:00 PT. :bell: :white_check_mark:

priya.k: Ran the pager test, received notification. I also verified Grafana dashboard access and can acknowledge alerts. Two small FYIs: (1) the Egress latency alert threshold is currently 10% lower than usual — might be noisy, (2) the nightly dedupe job sometimes spikes logs around 23:30.

sam: Re: dedupe job — we added a safeguard in the runbook (step 4) to mute non-critical alerts during the window. If you see a service-level error, escalate per runbook.

alex.m: Left a short note in the runbook under "evening handover" about the dedupe spike and where to find logs: `kail --ns prod svc/dedupe` and the quick query in Loki: `|~ "dedupe.*error"`.

priya.k: Thanks — I see the note. One more: do I need access to the KMS key mentioned by sam for decrypting webhook secrets?

sam: You should already have decrypt permissions via the `oncall` IAM group. If not, run `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=secrets.enc --location=global --keyring=redwood --key=pagerpro-routing` — infra can help if you hit perms.

priya.k: Permissions are fine. I decrypted the test payload. All good. :thumbsup:

alex.m: Perfect. If anything urgent pops up after I leave, page me but default to priya first. Leaving now, thanks everyone! :wave:

oncall-bot: reminder: please fill the post-shift checklist (https://redwood-internal/wiki/oncall-checkout) before you log out.

priya.k: Will do — thanks alex, logging into the rota now.

infra-bot: kms-key-check: OK — `pagerpro-routing` key is active and priya.k has decrypt role.

sam: cool, I'm around on slack if you need me for escalation.

priya.k: All set. Monitoring panels open and pager test passed. Taking over coverage.

alex.m: Thanks — appreciate it!
